rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly a review (title 'Drones in Plant Disease Assessment... A Way Forward to Smart Agriculture', labelled 'Review' in the journal header; Author Contributions describe no own experiment; Data Availability 'Not applicable'). It synthesises other studies on drone-based plant disease detection (Tables 2-4, Sections 2-3) and reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs, so Q1 is 'no' and Q2-Q9 follow. Further, the review's content concerns detection and monitoring of plant diseases rather than pest control per se, and says nothing about organic systems; at most it supports the monitoring/detection precondition of the claimed pest-control effect.

notes: Document is a narrative review (Agronomy 2023, 13, 1524) with no primary data; the text appears complete, with some duplicated passages from the publisher's layout.
